about: Ines waits in the hall. Marta arrives, walks to the garden and back, and leaves: Ines reads each `arrives` and `leaves` line and her sword answers each `:arrived` and `:departed`, while Marta is sent nothing of her own moves.

expect.words: A bare hall. A garden lies to the north.
A bare hall. A garden lies to the north.
Your sword glows as Marta comes near.
Your sword dims as Marta goes.
A bare hall. A garden lies to the north.
Your sword glows as Marta comes near.
You leave, and take what you carry with you.
Your sword dims as Marta goes.
